turns.text: Hey Lloyd, I'm deep into the Agent Zero setup today. It's interesting how it uses a plugin architecture with manifests defined in plugin.yaml. That structure seems pretty flexible.
That does sound robust. Did you manage to get the base agent running without issues?
Mostly, yes. Just had to tweak a few paths. Also, do you have a recommendation for a good Italian place nearby? I'm craving pasta.
Trattoria Bella is highly rated for their carbonara. Would that work for you?
Perfect. I'll book a table for two. Back to code, the yaml parsing was a bit slow at first.
Sometimes optimizing the loader helps. Let me know if you need any scripts for that.
Hi Lloyd, I've been looking into GR00T-Mimic. The components include Isaac Lab, CloudXR, GR00T-Mimic (trajectory extrapolation), Cosmos Transfer, and Robomimic/Isaac Lab. Quite a stack.
That is a comprehensive list. Are you planning to integrate all of those?
Eventually. Right now I'm just trying to get the environment stable. The weather outside is terrible, so I'm staying in.
Rainy days are good for coding. Did the installation go smoothly?
Not really. Had a conflict with the drivers. But I think I sorted it out.
Good to hear. Let me know if you hit another wall.
